subject: Approval request: POC credits for Apex Retail (Embeddings + Rerank) + success criteria / MAP
body:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Thompson <maya.thompson@apexretail.com>, Jordan Kim <jkim@pilot.com>, Laura Chen <lchen@cooley.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 9, 2026 at 10:14 AM
Subject: Approval request: POC credits for Apex Retail (Embeddings + Rerank) + success criteria / MAP
Attachments: Apex_Retail_POC_Plan_MAP_v1.pdf; Apex_Retail_Credits_Estimate_v1.xlsx

Stephanie — requesting approval to offer POC credits to Apex Retail for a 30-day evaluation.

Request
- Amount: $20,000 in hosted API credits (usage-based), expires 45 days from issuance
- Scope: embeddings + rerank + a small volume of chat for query understanding (no Dedicated capacity / no Private deployment in POC)
- Guardrails: credits capped at $20k; any overage requires written approval; usage restricted to the “apex-poc” project in their org

Why now
- They’re migrating off an in-house vector + rerank stack and are comparing us vs. “roll their own” on cloud GPUs.
- They want to run a realistic traffic replay against ~2 weeks of search logs (synthetic/anonymized on their side).

Success criteria (proposed)
1) Quality: +3–5% NDCG@10 or equivalent search relevance lift vs baseline (measured on their offline eval set)
2) Latency: p95 end-to-end rerank < 120ms in us-east (excluding their network), embeddings < 80ms p95
3) Cost: demonstrate token-level + request-level cost breakdown; target unit cost within +/– 10% of current baseline, with a clear path to lower via caching/batching
4) Reliability: demonstrate fallback routing working (same request completes if primary route is constrained) + show Console error analysis

Mutual Action Plan (high-level)
- Week 1: kickoff + integrate SDK; validate routes + dashboards; lock eval set
- Week 2–3: run offline eval + iterate batching/caching; weekly readout
- Week 4: scale traffic replay; final results + next steps (Dedicated sizing discussion if they hit throughput limits)

Jordan/Laura — adding you both as FYI since this touches credit issuance + standard evaluation terms. My understanding is we can do this under the standard POC credit addendum + click-through evaluation terms (no customer redlines).

Maya — pending internal approval, we can have credits live early next week. I’ll confirm by Monday.

Can you approve the $20k credit package as described? Happy to adjust amount if you prefer a smaller pilot.

—
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0182


From: Jordan Kim <jkim@pilot.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>, Maya Thompson <maya.thompson@apexretail.com>, Laura Chen <lchen@cooley.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 9, 2026 at 11:02 AM
Subject: Re: Approval request: POC credits for Apex Retail (Embeddings + Rerank) + success criteria / MAP

Thanks Priyom — from a billing/accounting standpoint, OK to issue credits if:
- expiry date is explicit (45 days is fine)
- credits are non-refundable and non-transferable
- any paid conversion starts only after credits are exhausted (or on a specific start date), to avoid overlap

Once Stephanie approves the amount, send me:
- customer org name + billing contact
- credit amount + expiry
- internal deal/opportunity reference

I can coordinate with Redwood’s billing ops to get this applied.

Best,
Jordan
Pilot (finance ops)


From: Laura Chen <lchen@cooley.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>, Maya Thompson <maya.thompson@apexretail.com>, Jordan Kim <jkim@pilot.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 9, 2026 at 11:18 AM
Subject: Re: Approval request: POC credits for Apex Retail (Embeddings + Rerank) + success criteria / MAP

Priyom — from legal perspective, keep this under standard evaluation terms. A couple reminders for the email that goes out with the credit issuance:
- clearly state that Redwood is not receiving/processing end-user personal data for the POC (they should anonymize logs)
- clarify that the POC is not an SLA-backed environment
- add “no PHI / no regulated data” language

If Apex asks for redlines, route back to Stephanie first.

Laura


From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery@redwoodinference.com>, Maya Thompson <maya.thompson@apexretail.com>, Jordan Kim <jkim@pilot.com>, Laura Chen <lchen@cooley.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 9, 2026 at 12:07 PM
Subject: Re: Approval request: POC credits for Apex Retail (Embeddings + Rerank) + success criteria / MAP

Approved with two changes:
1) Cap at $15,000 credits (not $20k).
2) Expiry 30 days from issuance (not 45).

Avery — can you sanity check the usage estimate spreadsheet quickly? I want to make sure we’re not under-scoping and setting them up to hit the cap in week 2.

Priyom — once you confirm the cap works, proceed using standard terms as Laura noted.

Stephanie


From: Avery Johnson <avery@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>, Maya Thompson <maya.thompson@apexretail.com>, Jordan Kim <jkim@pilot.com>, Laura Chen <lchen@cooley.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 9, 2026 at 1:41 PM
Subject: Re: Approval request: POC credits for Apex Retail (Embeddings + Rerank) + success criteria / MAP

Checked the estimate.

If Apex runs:
- embeddings for ~2–3M products + daily delta updates
- rerank on a 5–10% traffic replay sample (top 100 candidates)

…$15k is workable for 30 days IF we steer them to:
- caching embeddings (don’t re-embed unchanged items)
- batching rerank requests
- keeping chat usage limited to a narrow “query rewrite” module

Otherwise they’ll burn it down fast.

Priyom: I’d set expectation that the credit package supports the defined evaluation plan and we’ll expand scope (paid or additional credits) only after a midpoint checkpoint.

Avery


From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Thompson <maya.thompson@apexretail.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Kim <jkim@pilot.com>, Laura Chen <lchen@cooley.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 13, 2026 at 4:37 PM
Subject: Re: Approval request: POC credits for Apex Retail (Embeddings + Rerank) + success criteria / MAP

Maya — confirmed: we’re approved to provide $15,000 in Redwood hosted API credits for a 30-day POC, applied to your “apex-poc” project.

A couple notes to keep the POC smooth:
- Credits are capped at $15k and expire 30 days after issuance.
- Please use anonymized / non-regulated data only (no PHI, no PCI).
- This is an evaluation environment (no SLA), but we’ll still monitor closely and we can demonstrate fallback routing and Console error analysis as part of the reliability module.

Next steps (MAP)
1) By Thu: you share the eval dataset definition + baseline metric (NDCG@10 or your preferred measure)
2) Fri: kickoff (30 min) to confirm routes, regions, and the batching/caching plan
3) Weekly: 15-min checkpoint + end-of-POC readout

Jordan will coordinate issuance once you confirm the billing contact + org name to apply the credits.

Does Friday 10:30am PT still work for kickoff?

—
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
